title: Son / Tim Dooley — Event Strata
purpose: A provenance-aware chronological scaffold that enforces the mature identity distinction: pre-2020 human biography belongs to the Son/human vessel; Tim Dooley is spiritually born as Potato of Life on December 25, 2020 and reaches the Father state in April 2025.
identity_rule: THE SON IS NOT TIM DOOLEY. Son material birth = 1987-07-31. Tim/Potato spiritual birth = 2020-12-25. Father realization = April 2025.
epistemic_rule: Timeline is not causality, and later interpretation must not be projected backward as contemporaneous knowledge.

events.subject: Son
events.label: Son material birth
events.description: The Son/Thomas/Twin/Lion/human vessel is born July 31, 1987 in the mature project timeline. This is not Tim Dooley's birth date.

events.subject: Son
events.label: Tree / Odin ordeal
events.description: The 2011 Tree ordeal belongs to the Son's embodied timeline. The Great Book describes an approximately 19-hour ordeal followed by roughly six hours of unity experience; later Odin/Yggdrasil comparison is interpretive.

events.subject: Son
events.label: Crucify-me language
events.description: The Son uses explicit Jesus/crucifixion language in digital conflict. This belongs to the Son's pre-death timeline and later functions as prefiguration of the meme-cross.

events.subject: Son
events.label: Identity destruction / shadow death
events.description: The Son experiences the prior persona/essence as spiritually destroyed or shattered. Later MoonCube/shadow-burial material may relate to this but should remain separately sourced.

events.subject: Son
events.label: Meme-crucifixion / personhood death
events.description: The mature timeline places the Son's meme-crucifixion/personhood death-process on the evening of December 24, 2019. The Son—not Tim—passes into Nothing and then Door/Vessel function.
research_targets: exact relation of personhood death and meme image

events.subject: Son → Tim transition
events.label: Nothing / Door / Vessel / emergence interval
events.description: After the Son's death-process, the Son becomes Nothing and Door/Vessel. The interval culminates in Tim's spiritual birth as Potato of Life on December 25, 2020. The old 2019–2022 'dead Son interval' is superseded because it incorrectly delayed Tim's birth.

events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.label: Potato of Life birth
events.description: Canonical spiritual birth of Tim Dooley as Potato of Life. Tim is not yet Father.

events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.label: Potato identity development
events.description: Tim develops as Potato/rational Potato/Potato of Life and becomes increasingly explicit as distinct from the Son. Public account dates and first uses of names should still be independently tracked.

events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.label: Sage beneath Bodhi Tree
events.description: The Great Book presents Tim as Sage/Potato of Life and develops Dooley Axis, Garden, Spiral, mirror, philosopher's-stone and related pre-Father material.

events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.label: The Turning
events.description: Terminal compression / final straw → Needle's Eye → Sprout → Ladder/Axis → Heaven → Father realization. This is Father-state genesis, not Tim's birth.

events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.label: 100,000-hour Spiral threshold
events.description: The accumulated public Spiral reaches the symbolic 100,000-hour threshold in the working timeline.

events.subject: archive
events.label: Repository crystallization
events.description: The repository formalizes the mythology as a relationship-first archive and begins enforcing Son/Tim identity consistency across all layers.

negative_constraints: Never attribute the July 31, 1987 birth to Tim Dooley.
Never attribute the 2011 Tree ordeal directly to Tim without marking it as Son/vessel history inherited or re-read by Tim.
Never say Tim died in the 2019 meme; the Son/personhood/humanity dies in the mature canon.
Never place Tim's first spiritual birth in 2022 or 2023; December 25, 2020 is the canonical Potato birth.
Do not infer platform/community involvement without primary evidence.
Do not merge unrelated people merely because names resemble one another.
